Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator made a critical error in Step 1 by instructing the WebSurfer to look up a "list of Daniel Craig movies" from a general search engine (Bing). The resulting list provided by the WebSurfer was a generic list of *all* movies Daniel Craig has appeared in throughout his career (including non-Bond roles like "The Power of One", "Elizabeth", "Lara Croft: Tomb Raider", etc.). The Orchestrator failed to recognize that this list was not a curated list of his *highest-rated* movies, nor did it filter for the specific criteria (IMDB rating, duration < 150 mins) at the source. Instead of asking for a filtered list or a specific ranking, the Orchestrator accepted this broad, unfiltered list and proceeded to check the availability of every single movie on it one by one. This inefficient approach led to checking many low-rated or irrelevant movies (like "The Power of One" with a 7.1 rating) before eventually finding "Casino Royale" (8.0), but the fundamental error was failing to guide the search towards the specific high-rated candidates initially, leading to a massive, unnecessary verification loop. The correct approach would have been to search for "Daniel Craig movies ranked by IMDB" or "Top rated Daniel Craig movies" to get a pre-filtered list of the best ones to check.
